owner_decision_required:
Three named grounds require an owner decision.

1 BRAND MARK — concept #97 does NOT depict the approved BBROSE asset. The approved asset is a tight SERIF wordmark with a FILLED rose medallion and a registered mark, raster-only. The concept shows a letterspaced geometric SANS with an OUTLINED line-art medallion and no registered mark. No authoritative VECTOR logo exists and Image Trace is prohibited, so no third mark may be synthesized. Choose: (A) reconstruct what #97 shows, (B) reconstruct the approved mark and accept deviation from #97, or (C) supply an authoritative vector logo.

2 PRODUCT-NAME TYPEFACE — the reference product name is a CONDENSED high-contrast Didone. At the measured cap heights every locally available Didone is far wider: Bodoni 72 is 1.41x on Rose and 1.33x on Damascena, Didot 1.61x and 1.54x. Matching the reference width would need negative tracking (-18.1 px, -11.7 px apparent), which collides glyphs, or scaling to ~0.71-0.75, which stretches them. Both are blocking defects under §15, so neither was used: natural tracking is set and the width error is reported. A licensed condensed Didone is required.

3 ROSE MEDALLION — not invented. Its measured bounds are parked as a non-printing guide and the glyph slot is empty while still consuming its advance.

No VQ2-A2 was generated and none will be without instruction.
